implementation.SLASHING: Replaced the single fading ring-arc with two arcs sweeping the same path at offset speeds (a bright additive-blended leading edge, a dimmer wider trailing wake), plus a real THREE.Points spark burst that releases tangent to the blade's current sweep angle rather than radiating from a fixed center - reads as grit kicked off a moving blade, not a static shape.
implementation.FIRE: Added a fireball corona: three small flame-tongue cones parented to the shared approach projectile, orbiting it during travel (previously every damage type shared one identical glowing-orb projectile with no type-specific silhouette). Extended the shared comet trail from 3 to 5 segments with additive blending and a two-tone gradient (hot core color into the accent color further back). Impact now uses a THREE.Points ember burst (28 particles) instead of 4 discrete ember spheres.
implementation.COLD: Swapped the plain boxGeometry ice block for an icosahedron with meshPhysicalMaterial's ior and clearcoat properties added (physically-based frosted-glass look, not just transmission+roughness as before). Added a THREE.Points frost-mist burst (22 particles) that releases at the shatter moment alongside the existing shard shatter.
implementation.remaining10Types: Added blending={AdditiveBlending} to every material that represents actual light/energy across PIERCING (flash, cracks), THUNDER (shockwave rings), LIGHTNING (bolt segments), RADIANT (beam, rays, flash), PSYCHIC (warp rings), and FORCE (shards) - genuine additive light-stacking rather than flat opaque color. Deliberately left BLUDGEONING's dust ring, ACID's puddle/droplets, POISON's gas puffs, and NECROTIC's tendrils/pulse on normal blending, since additive would make physical debris, liquid, and gas read as glowing energy, which is wrong for what those types represent.

sharedInfrastructureAdded: A generic Points-particle burst system (burstPositions() for seeding deterministic outward-cone directions, animateBurst() for expanding/fading a burst by progress) was added to RefBag/DamageEffect rather than writing bespoke particle-animation code per type, so FIRE's embers and COLD's frost mist share one real implementation. SLASHING's spark burst needed a different motion (tangent-to-blade, not radial-from-center) so it animates inline rather than through animateBurst().
executedValidation: python tools/architecture-check.py / accessibility-check.py / ui-quality-check.py: all passed

notYetDone: No live screenshot verification of the other 10 damage types (BLUDGEONING, PIERCING, ACID, THUNDER, LIGHTNING, POISON, RADIANT, NECROTIC, PSYCHIC, FORCE) individually - only SLASHING/FIRE/COLD (the three the operator named explicitly) were triggered and screenshotted. The additive-blending changes to the other 6 types with glow-type materials were verified by code review and a clean typecheck, not by individually triggering and watching each one.
